response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Time Traveler's Terror' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching the killer. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her expertise to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. As the body count rises, Rachel must navigate the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, all while trying to find a way back to her own time. But as the killer's modus operandi becomes increasingly sophisticated, Rachel realizes that she may be the only one who can prevent a catastrophic future.
